citations.text: The printed headword is 幫(帮), read bāng. The entry calls 幫 a phonosemantic character formed from 帛 with 封 as phonetic and gives the proposed original meaning as the edge of a shoe, citing 集韻·唐韻 “帮，治履边也.” It then describes extensions involving raised sides of objects, assistance, groups, and a classifier. It says 帮 appeared in the modern period as a俗字 of 幫 and proposes that the lower 帛 was reduced to 巾. This is the book author’s analysis; the passage does not date 帮’s first appearance or establish a step-by-step graphic route. The visible printed page is 695. PDF p.709 / printed p.696 begins 白部 entries; 幫 does not continue there. I inspected the headword, prose and adjacent entry boundary in the supplied pixels; I did not interpret the entry’s glyph specimens as historical forms.
